note: Documents reproduced as they are. Colour and shading are the document's own, carried in the JSON rather than mapped onto app theme tokens, so scripts/check-doc-contrast.mjs checks each (text colour, fill) pair the data actually uses. The source .docx files are private material and are not in this repository; each entry records the source name and its SHA-256.
